response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years across web, mobile, and backend systems, and demonstrable low-latency/high-throughput distributed systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby). However, the role centers on hands-on C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project; the last decade has been TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and React. There is no evidence of MQTT, message-broker-based industrial applications, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Azure. The listed skills section omits C++ entirely. Strong engineering fundamentals and mentoring ability do not offset the core technology and domain gap for a mid-senior specialist hire.
strengths: Proven high-performance, low-latency distributed systems and concurrency work
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and workshops
Broad full-stack range including Node.js, React, TypeScript, Docker/Kubernetes
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~6 months, 2014-2015)
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or IEC 62443/SDL security background
No Azure or industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3) exposure

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation & IEC 62443 security domain gap
